title: verify_did_sig Result<bool> is a leaky abstraction
description: verify_did_sig returns Result<bool, DidSigError> where Ok(false) means 'signature did not verify' and Ok(true) means it did. This forces callers into two-level destructuring (match on Result, then check the bool) and makes it easy to treat Ok(false) as success. A cleaner signature is Result<(), DidSigError> where VerificationFailed is a normal Err variant returned by the function, or a dedicated VerifyOutcome enum. The current shape also makes DidSigError::VerificationFailed a dead variant -- it exists in the enum but verify_did_sig never returns it as Err.
